messages.subject: Model broken: models/transform/simplex
parts:
I haven't checked to see what's going on yet, but models/transform/simplex is failing.


$ models/transforms/simplex
Exception: vari destruction handled automatically
Diagnostic information:
Dynamic exception type: std::logic_error
std::exception::what: vari destruction handled automatically


Daniel

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: Model broken: models/transform/simplex
parts:
I fixed it. It was in the generated code Bob and I worked on yesterday.

The generated code went from:

stan::agrad::vari DUMMY_VARI__(std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(),false);
stan::agrad::vari* DUMMY_VARI_PTR__ = &DUMMY_VARI__;
stan::agrad::var DUMMY_VAR__ = var(DUMMY_VARI_PTR__);

to:

stan::agrad::vari* DUMMY_VARI_PTR__ = new vari(std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(),false);
stan::agrad::var DUMMY_VAR__ = var(DUMMY_VARI_PTR__);


That call to new() is using the arena based allocator. There is no leak by not deleting it. It avoids the problem of having DUMMY_VARI__ trigger the std::logic_error on automatic destruction.

As far as I can tell, we can't push the allocation of the vari into the class somewhere because it will be "deallocated" when the gradient is calculated.

Anyone see any problems with this change?




Daniel
